page: Alibaba Cloud ecs.hfg6.16xlarge is an x86_64 architecture server instance powered by the Intel Xeon 8269CY processor. Running on a KVM hypervisor, this instance features 64 dedicated physical cores and 64 vCPUs operating at a clock speed of 3.1 GHz with a 1.0 thread-per-core configuration. It is equipped with 256.0 GB of system memory, providing a balanced allocation of 4.0 GB of RAM per core.

This instance does not include local storage or integrated GPUs, meaning all storage requirements must be met through external network-attached block storage. Network connectivity is supported by a baseline bandwidth of 20 Gbps. The absence of local NVMe drives and hardware accelerators represents a clear tradeoff, positioning this instance away from storage-heavy or GPU-dependent workloads.

From a cost-efficiency perspective, the dedicated CPU allocation and high clock speed provide predictable compute performance for multi-threaded applications without the overhead of hyperthreading. The 1:4 vCPU-to-RAM ratio makes it suitable for general-purpose workloads, medium-sized databases, application servers, and containerized microservices that require consistent CPU performance and moderate memory capacity.
